en: A black‑and‑white historical photograph showing a small canal lined with a stone embankment and simple metal railing. A two‑story plastered house with a steep tiled roof stands directly on the canal, with wooden annexes extending over the water. A few leafless trees grow along the wide street on the opposite side. People in early 20th‑century European clothing—men in long coats and hats, uniformed officers, and children—stroll or pose along the canal and the street. In the background are modest town buildings and a tree‑lined square.
